Show a level as a glass filling with water

Source: R/glass_fill.R
glass_fill.Rd

Draws a glass of water filled up to a level between 0 and 1. The surface of the water moves gently, bubbles rise from the base and the water sloshes when the mouse moves across the chart. When the chart scrolls into view, the water rises from empty to the level while the percentage above the glass counts up.

Usage

glass_fill(
  fill_level = 0.65,
  glass_width = NULL,
  glass_height = NULL,
  stroke_color = "#555",
  stroke_width = 2.5,
  fill_color = "#5aa9e6",
  render_fill_label = TRUE,
  label_font_size = NULL,
  title_text = "Fill level",
  label_color = "#333",
  title_color = "#333",
  title_font_size = 14,
  font = "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif",
  target = NULL,
  ticks = FALSE,
  waves = TRUE,
  bubbles = TRUE,
  draggable = FALSE,
  animate = TRUE,
  bg_col = "white",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

Arguments

fill_level

A number between 0 and 1: how full the glass is (values outside are clamped). Defaults to 0.65.

glass_width

Optional. The width of the glass (at the rim) in pixels. By default it is 64 percent of the height of the glass.

glass_height

Optional. The height of the glass in pixels. By default the glass fills the space available (up to 340 pixels).

stroke_color

The colour of the glass. Defaults to "#555".

stroke_width

The width of the outline of the glass. Defaults to 2.5.

fill_color

The colour of the water. Defaults to "#5aa9e6".

render_fill_label

Logical. Show the percentage above the glass. Defaults to TRUE.

label_font_size

Optional. The font size of the percentage, a number or a CSS size such as "16px". By default it grows with the glass.

title_text

Optional. A caption below the glass. Defaults to "Fill level"; use NULL to hide it.

label_color

The colour of the percentage, the scale and the target label. Defaults to "#333".

title_color

The colour of the caption. Defaults to "#333".

title_font_size

The font size of the caption, a number or a CSS size such as "14px". Defaults to 14.

font

The font family. Defaults to "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif".

target

Optional. A level between 0 and 1 marked with a dashed line and a label.

ticks

Logical. Draw a measuring scale (25, 50, 75 and 100 percent) on the glass. Defaults to FALSE.

waves

Logical. Animate the surface of the water. Defaults to TRUE.

bubbles

Logical. Show bubbles rising in the water. Defaults to TRUE.

draggable

Logical. Let the viewer change the level by dragging or with the arrow keys. Defaults to FALSE.

animate

Logical. Fill the glass from empty when it first comes into view. Defaults to TRUE.

bg_col

The background colour. Defaults to "white".

width

Optional. The width of the chart.

height

Optional. The height of the chart.

Value

An r2d3 htmlwidget.

Interactions

  • Move the mouse across the chart: the water rocks from side to side.

  • Click the glass: a drop falls into it and splashes.

  • With draggable = TRUE, drag up or down on the glass to set the level, or focus the chart (click it or press Tab) and use the arrow keys (1 percent per press, 10 with Shift).

Shiny

Inside Shiny, with r2d3::d3Output("id") and r2d3::renderD3(), clicking the glass sets input$id_clicked to a list with value, and, with draggable = TRUE, setting a level sets input$id_value to the new level (a number between 0 and 1). When the chart is re-rendered with a new level, the water moves from the old level to the new one.

Examples

glass_fill(fill_level = 0.75)


glass_fill(
  fill_level = 0.3,
  target = 0.8,
  ticks = TRUE,
  title_text = "Water intake today"
)


glass_fill(0.5, fill_color = "#efb118", draggable = TRUE, title_text = "Drag me")
